Cut and Sew Clothing Manufacturing from Tech Pack to Delivery

Updated: July 1, 2026 | By FABRIOZA

When your design is unique — a specific silhouette, unconventional construction, or proprietary pattern — cut and sew manufacturing is the only way to achieve it. FABRIOZA offers full cut-and-sew production from pattern making to finished garment, with MOQ starting at 50 pieces.

What is Cut and Sew Manufacturing?

Cut and sew means garments are built from raw fabric rather than decorating pre-made blanks. The process: your tech pack → pattern creation → fabric sourcing → marker making → fabric cutting → sewing → finishing → quality control. Every step is custom to your specifications.

Our Cut & Sew Capabilities

Pattern Making

Our pattern masters convert your tech packs or reference garments into production-ready patterns. We use CAD pattern software for precision grading across all sizes (XS-5XL or custom).

Fabric Sourcing

Access to 200+ certified fabric types: cotton, polyester, spandex, rayon, linen, bamboo, organic cotton, recycled fabrics, and technical performance materials. Full traceability on every roll.

Sample Development

First sample in 5-7 days. Unlimited revisions until you're satisfied. We photograph every sample from multiple angles and provide detailed measurement sheets.

Bulk Production

15 automated production lines with 200+ skilled operators. Daily capacity of 2,500+ units. In-line quality checks at every production stage.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a tech pack and do I need one?

A tech pack is a technical document with measurements, materials, and construction details. We can work with sketches, reference garments, or complete tech packs.

How long does cut and sew sampling take?

First sample: 5-7 days. Revisions: 3-5 days each. Most clients approve within 2-3 samples.

What fabrics can you source?

200+ certified fabrics including cotton, polyester, spandex, bamboo, organic, recycled, and technical performance fabrics.

Is cut and sew more expensive than blanks?

Yes, 15-30% more per unit, but the quality, fit, and brand differentiation are significantly higher.

Can you copy a garment I send?

Yes, send us a reference garment and we'll create a perfect pattern and sample.
